Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionLove Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily is a narrative-driven spot-the-difference puzzle game about love, memory, and the moments that shape a lifetime. Now elderly, Riku looks through an old photo album with his grandchildren and tells them the story of his life with Lily. Some memories have begun to fade, appearing in grayscale throughout the album. By finding the differences hidden within each illustrated scene, you help Riku reconstruct those memories and restore the pages to full color. Follow Riku and Lily across 21 chapters, from their younger years through adulthood, family life, and old age. Although they are very different from one another, their story shows how love can grow alongside those differences.
